_comment: Words that must not appear in the plain (Simple layer) text of Intelligence: UI strings, and the per-check plain text served by the API (ziira/modules/intel/domain/plain_checks.json). Matched as whole words, case-insensitively. Technical words may appear only in the 'technical details' section, which is why those strings live under a `tech` key that the test skips. Used by frontend/src/modules/intel/plainWords.test.ts and tests/test_intel_plain.py.
